summary: Register an app in Microsoft Entra (Azure). For multi-tenant apps that ask for more than basic sign-in, unverified publishers can face consent warnings or blocks; publisher verification is free but needs a verified Partner account.

difficulty.label: Review required
difficulty.rationale: Registration is instant, but Microsoft says users may be unable to consent to newly registered multitenant apps that are not publisher verified when risk-based step-up consent is enabled; verification needs a verified partner account and domain.

effort.basis: Our estimate for registration plus secret and permissions. Publisher verification time is unknown.

wait.statement: Microsoft says developers who already meet the publisher-verification requirements can be verified in minutes. How long it takes to get the Partner account itself verified is not stated.
wait.headline: Minutes, once set up
wait.note: Publisher verification takes minutes once you have a verified Partner account. How long that account takes is not stated.

composio_managed.note: Not checked against the Composio API yet.

requirements.text: Publisher verification needs a verified Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program (formerly MPN) account that is the partner global account, an app registered in a Microsoft Entra work/school tenant, a publisher domain that is not *.onmicrosoft.com, and MFA for the initiating user.
No charges are associated with completing the prerequisites for publisher verification.
Publisher verification needs a Partner One ID on a verified Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program account.

scopes_and_access.text: Composio's example uses delegated Microsoft Graph permissions Mail.Read, Mail.Send, offline_access and openid/profile/email.

gotchas.text: The client secret you need is the secret Value, not the secret ID, and it is shown only once.
Secrets expire (6 or 12 months recommended in Composio's guide); plan rotation.
Choosing 'Allow all tenants' means any Microsoft organization can authenticate with your app.
Apps registered with a personal Microsoft account cannot be publisher-verified.
Client secrets expire: the maximum lifetime is 24 months and Microsoft recommends under 12. Calendar the renewal or your connection will fail one day.
Redirect URIs are case-sensitive and must match the path of your running app exactly.
Wildcard redirect URIs are not supported for apps that sign in both personal Microsoft accounts and work/school accounts.
Microsoft recommends a certificate rather than a client secret before production.

steps.title: Register the app in Entra
steps.detail: App registrations > New registration; choose supported account types (Composio uses 'any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts'); platform Web; redirect URI from your Composio auth config.

steps.title: Create a client secret
steps.detail: Certificates & secrets > New client secret; copy the Value immediately.
steps.why_not_agent: Secret goes to your secret store.

steps.title: Add delegated Graph permissions
steps.detail: For Outlook mail: Mail.Read, Mail.Send, offline_access, openid, profile, email.

steps.title: Create the Composio auth config and connect
steps.detail: Own developer credentials; enter client ID, secret, redirect URI; connect an account and test a tool.

steps.title: If other organizations will use it: pursue publisher verification
steps.detail: Set a publisher domain, verify your Partner account, associate the PartnerID with the app.
steps.why_not_agent: Needs partner account, MFA and domain ownership.

blockers.symptom: Users from another company see a warning or cannot consent
blockers.likely_cause: Unverified publisher on a multitenant app requesting permissions beyond basic sign-in.
blockers.fix: Complete publisher verification, or ask the tenant admin to grant consent.
blockers.escalate_when: Tenant policy blocks all unverified apps and the admin will not grant consent.

review_process.text: Publisher verification verifies the organization is authentic; the badge does not indicate app quality.
Multitenant apps that are not publisher verified show a warning on the consent screen for users in other tenants.

next_actions: Register the app and test with your own tenant.
Start partner account verification early if other organizations will connect.

agent_can: Check your publisher-verification prerequisites against the list.
Build the Composio config from credentials.
you_must: Register the app, handle secrets, and own the partner/domain verification.
